title: TEST CHAMBER 12

addedBoxes.note: Staff landing at y = 3.6; underside y = 3.2 leaves the lower east door clear. Continue to z = 5 at the existing upper exit.
Privacy screen conceals the southern staircase. Its entrance is around the west end at x = 2.3.
Fix: staff bridge north to the shell catwalk at the real staff hatch (z -4.5); the high route otherwise dead-ends at the wall above the door.

solution: Possess the arm and press the button at (-5.8, 1.3, 0.5), releasing the crate and opening the staff hatch.
Possess the drone, fly to (9, 5.1, -6), and zap the panel at (9, 6.6, -7.5) to set override.

Possess the arm, pick up the released crate at (-4.6, 1.1, -2), and carry it at centre height y = 1.1 for 8.3 m east along z = -2 to the floor plate at (3.7, -2). Set it down with its centre below y = 1.2; do not throw it.
With override set and the crate on the plate, possess the base and walk across the floor to the east door at z = 5.

Hidden: after the same button, override and crate sequence, take the base around the screen's west end to x = 2, z = 7.1 on the floor. Jump east along the six 1.4 m treads, gaining only 0.6 m each time. From the y = 3.6 landing, walk north to z = 5 and east through the opened staff hatch above y = 3.
